summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) filed a Form 6-K reporting minutes of a July 31, 2026 board meeting. Actions included exonerating Nitin Prabhu as coordinator of the Innovation and Technology Committee, electing Daniel Barriuso Rojo as new coordinator, and ratifying the committee's composition. These routine committee changes are internal governance matters with no strategic, financial, or structural significance. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or management departure was announced. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report, and no category applies.
